Mandatory CAD-First Execution

General Arrangement & Schematic Approval Before Fabrication.

We eliminate site surprises by submitting complete AutoCAD / EPLAN General Arrangement (GA) layouts, compartmentalization drawings, and ferruled wiring schematics for your consultant or plant team’s sign-off before a single 2.0mm CRCA sheet is cut.

01

Load Schedule & Vendor-Neutral BOM Alignment

Our estimation engineers review your SLD, short-circuit kA rating, switchroom trench dimensions, and preferred switchgear/PLC makes.

02

CAD General Arrangement (GA) & Schematic Submittal

Detailed dimensional GA drawings, feeder compartment layouts, and numbered control schematics submitted for formal approval.

03

Raw Material Allocation & 2.0mm CRCA Fabrication

CNC sheet metal fabrication, 7-tank chemical pretreatment, RAL 7035 powder coating, and verified component allocation from our Storage Bay.

04

Busbar Fitment, Switchgear & Ferruled Cable Assembly

Electrolytic Cu/Al busbar mounting on DMC supports followed by computerized cross-ferruled 1.1kV FRLS harness wiring and safe industrial dispatch.

Interactive Blueprint Viewer

General Arrangement (GA) Dimensional Layout

Every panel ships with a laminated copy of its approved General Arrangement and numbered control schematic stored inside the door document pocket.
